exact.cancellation_set: C_xi={(Re(rho)-Re(rho'))/2>0: xi(rho)=xi(rho')=0 and Im(rho)=Im(rho')}; C_xi is countable
exact.closure_criterion: RH iff 0 belongs to closure(D) iff D contains a sequence omega_n->0
exact.determinant_property: D(omega): for one (equivalently every) integer nu with nu*omega>1, det(I+/-K_(omega,nu)[t])!=0 for every t>=0
exact.determinants_to_inner: All finite strict contractions extend to a bounded causal convolution multiplier equal to Theta_omega^nu, hence Theta_omega is meromorphic inner
exact.fixed_pair_equivalence: D(omega) iff Theta_omega is meromorphic inner in C+ iff m_xi(rho-2*omega)>=m_xi(rho) for every xi-zero rho with Re(rho)>1/2+omega
exact.growth_guard: No poles and real-boundary modulus one do not imply innerness for an arbitrary meromorphic function: exp(-i*z) is unbounded in C+; the xi high-strip bound is essential
exact.inner_to_determinants: Theta_omega inner gives a full L2 isometry; Suzuki's noncompact-support lemma and compact truncations give ||K_(omega,nu)[t]||<1 for every finite t
exact.local_exclusion: If RH is false, one off-line zero rho and zero isolation give epsilon_rho>0 such that D(omega) fails for every 0<omega<epsilon_rho
exact.no_poles_to_inner: For the xi quotient, no poles in C+ plus Suzuki's high-strip bound and Phragmen-Lindelof imply Theta_omega in H-infinity(C+)
exact.open_scalar_target: Prove the L2 residual, or the stronger eventual one-sign condition, for a sequence omega_n->0 by direct arithmetic bounds without assuming a zero-free half-plane
exact.pole_coordinate: rho=beta+i*gamma maps to z_rho=-gamma+i*(beta-1/2-omega); the numerator there is xi(rho-2*omega)
exact.power_independence: Theta_omega^nu is inner for one positive integer nu iff Theta_omega is inner iff Theta_omega^mu is inner for every positive integer mu
exact.summatory_l2: Theta_omega inner iff x^(-1/2)*1_(1,infinity)(x)-h_omega^<1>(x) belongs to L2(1,infinity)
exact.summatory_sign: If h_omega^<1>(x) has one sign for all sufficiently large x, then Theta_omega is inner

polynomial_checks.chain_conclusion: The reduced ratio is inner although F has nonreal zeros; one fixed shift cannot force all zeros real.
polynomial_checks.defect_conclusion: The unmatched multiplicity leaves a pole at z=2i.

proof_boundary: This artifact identifies the fixed-omega Suzuki determinant property with meromorphic innerness and an exact shifted-zero multiplicity condition, subject to independent review of the combined operator argument. It does not prove that the condition holds at any subcritical omega, does not prove eventual sign or the L2 summatory residual, and does not prove RH or Lambda<=0.

rows.claim: The admissible fixed-shift determinant property is independent of the auxiliary power.
rows.formula: D(omega): for one (equivalently every) integer nu with nu*omega>1, det(I+/-K_(omega,nu)[t])!=0 for every t>=0
rows.proof_boundary: Independence is proved only after the inner-function equivalence.

rows.claim: All-time determinant nonvanishing produces a contractive causal multiplier.
rows.formula: All finite strict contractions extend to a bounded causal convolution multiplier equal to Theta_omega^nu, hence Theta_omega is meromorphic inner
rows.proof_boundary: Uses the separately audited dense-form extension and causal multiplier theorem.

rows.claim: The xi functional equations make the quotient unimodular on the real boundary.
rows.formula: Theta_omega(u)=conj(xi(1/2+omega-i*u))/xi(1/2+omega-i*u), so |Theta_omega(u)|=1 wherever defined
rows.proof_boundary: Boundary values alone do not supply boundedness in C+.

rows.claim: Innerness of one positive integral power is equivalent to innerness of the base quotient.
rows.formula: Theta_omega^nu is inner for one positive integer nu iff Theta_omega is inner iff Theta_omega^mu is inner for every positive integer mu
rows.proof_boundary: A pole or modulus excess survives every positive power.

rows.claim: Every upper-half-plane pole is an off-line xi zero in explicit coordinates.
rows.formula: rho=beta+i*gamma maps to z_rho=-gamma+i*(beta-1/2-omega); the numerator there is xi(rho-2*omega)
rows.proof_boundary: Only zeros strictly to the right of 1/2+omega lie in C+.

rows.claim: Pole removal is exactly a horizontal shifted-zero multiplicity inequality.
rows.formula: ord_pole(z_rho)=max(0,m_xi(rho)-m_xi(rho-2*omega))
rows.proof_boundary: A common zero cancels only to the smaller multiplicity.

rows.claim: For this xi quotient, absence of poles is sufficient for meromorphic innerness.
rows.formula: For the xi quotient, no poles in C+ plus Suzuki's high-strip bound and Phragmen-Lindelof imply Theta_omega in H-infinity(C+)
rows.proof_boundary: This is Suzuki's fixed-omega Phragmen-Lindelof argument and is not a generic boundary principle.

rows.claim: Meromorphic innerness gives strict norm less than one for every compact truncation.
rows.formula: Theta_omega inner gives a full L2 isometry; Suzuki's noncompact-support lemma and compact truncations give ||K_(omega,nu)[t]||<1 for every finite t
rows.proof_boundary: The proof uses Suzuki's noncompact-support lemma and nu*omega>1 compactness.

rows.claim: The fixed-omega Fredholm problem is exactly a zero-pair cancellation problem.
rows.formula: D(omega) iff Theta_omega is meromorphic inner in C+ iff m_xi(rho-2*omega)>=m_xi(rho) for every xi-zero rho with Re(rho)>1/2+omega
rows.proof_boundary: The combined equivalence should receive independent expert review.

rows.claim: All exceptional shifts that can hide a right-hand zero form a countable set.
rows.formula: C_xi={(Re(rho)-Re(rho'))/2>0: xi(rho)=xi(rho')=0 and Im(rho)=Im(rho')}; C_xi is countable
rows.proof_boundary: Countability does not make an explicitly chosen omega provably generic.

rows.claim: Outside the cancellation set, D(omega) is equivalent to the zero-free half-plane Re(s)>1/2+omega.
rows.formula: omega not in C_xi => [D(omega) iff xi(s)!=0 for Re(s)>1/2+omega]
rows.proof_boundary: This is a generic-parameter equivalence, not a zero-free proof.

rows.claim: The maximal horizontal zero displacement is the determinant phase threshold.
rows.formula: delta_xi=sup_{xi(rho)=0}(Re(rho)-1/2) in [0,1/2]
rows.proof_boundary: The value delta_xi=0 is exactly RH.

rows.claim: Apart from countably many possible cancellation shifts below threshold, D is a sharp half-line.
rows.formula: [delta_xi,infinity) subset D subset [delta_xi,infinity) union (C_xi intersect (0,delta_xi))
rows.proof_boundary: The exceptional points need not themselves satisfy D.

rows.claim: If RH fails, all sufficiently small shifts fail the determinant property.
rows.formula: If RH is false, one off-line zero rho and zero isolation give epsilon_rho>0 such that D(omega) fails for every 0<omega<epsilon_rho
rows.proof_boundary: The exclusion radius depends on an unknown off-line zero.

rows.claim: Cofinality can be weakened to the topological statement that zero is a limit point of successful shifts.
rows.formula: RH iff 0 belongs to closure(D) iff D contains a sequence omega_n->0
rows.proof_boundary: This remains an RH-equivalent criterion, not evidence that such shifts exist.

rows.claim: A finite vertical zero chain makes one fixed quotient inner despite nonreal zeros.
rows.proof_boundary: This tests fixed-shift logic only; its rational quotient is not Suzuki's decaying xi kernel.

rows.claim: Insufficient lower multiplicity leaves an uncancelled upper-half-plane pole.
rows.proof_boundary: This validates the direction and multiplicity in the zero-shift rule.

rows.claim: Boundary unimodularity and pole-freeness are not enough without the xi growth input.
rows.formula: No poles and real-boundary modulus one do not imply innerness for an arbitrary meromorphic function: exp(-i*z) is unbounded in C+; the xi high-strip bound is essential
rows.proof_boundary: Suzuki's high-strip estimate and Phragmen-Lindelof step must remain explicit.

rows.claim: Suzuki's Jordan-totient weighted residual is an exact scalar test for the same innerness gate.
rows.formula: Theta_omega inner iff x^(-1/2)*1_(1,infinity)(x)-h_omega^<1>(x) belongs to L2(1,infinity)
rows.proof_boundary: The residual is global on (1,infinity); finite samples do not certify it.

rows.claim: Eventual one-sign behavior of the weighted summatory function is a stronger scalar route.
rows.formula: If h_omega^<1>(x) has one sign for all sufficiently large x, then Theta_omega is inner
rows.proof_boundary: Positive coefficients alone do not decide the signed weight transform.

rows.claim: The operator gate can be attacked through one explicit arithmetic summatory function.
rows.formula: Prove the L2 residual, or the stronger eventual one-sign condition, for a sequence omega_n->0 by direct arithmetic bounds without assuming a zero-free half-plane
rows.proof_boundary: This target is RH-strength on a cofinal sequence and must not be inferred from finite positivity.
